mapper.select: SELECT login_id FROM users WHERE id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND login_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET login_id = #{loginId}, password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND login_id IS NULL
